hero.eyebrow: Natural mineral water · Niague spring, Senegal
hero.subtitle: Drawn from the heart of a preserved nature, naturally filtered through rock. Exceptional purity, balanced mineral content.

brandTeaser.title: Senegalese pride, raised to world standards
brandTeaser.text: O'Crystal was born from a simple ambition: to give Senegal and the sub-region a mineral water of impeccable purity, with the elegance of a great house.

sourceTeaser.title: From rock to bottle
sourceTeaser.text: The water flows slowly through the mineral layers of Niague, taking on calcium and magnesium, then is bottled at the source.

minerality.title: 320 mg/L of balanced minerality
minerality.text: Dry residue at 180 °C. A light water with fine, refreshing bubbles.

journey.title: From the Niague rock to the bottle

filtration.title: Natural filtration
filtration.text: As it passes through rock layers, it purifies and takes on calcium, magnesium and bicarbonates.

bottling.title: Bottled at the source
bottling.text: Drawn and bottled on site, the water keeps its original purity intact — nothing is added.

sourcePage.title: From the Niague rock to your glass
sourcePage.intro: Water drawn from the heart of a preserved nature, naturally filtered, bottled at the source.
sourcePage.compositionText: Dry residue at 180 °C: 320 mg/L. A light water with fine, refreshing bubbles.
sourcePage.certText: ISO 22000 and HACCP processes underway. The full mineral analysis is available for download.
sourcePage.why1Text: The rock retains impurities and enriches the water with essential minerals.
sourcePage.why2Text: No transport before bottling: the original purity is preserved.
sourcePage.why3Text: A delicate effervescence — the signature of a living, light water.
sourcePage.process1: Catchment & treatment — reverse osmosis, continuous monitoring
sourcePage.process2: Bottled at source — closed line, no interruption
sourcePage.process3: Every format, the same water — checked before dispatch

brandPage.title: Senegalese pride, raised to world standards
brandPage.intro: O'Crystal was born from a conviction: Senegal deserves an exceptional mineral water, carried with the elegance of a great house.

chapters.title: One source, one promise
chapters.text: In the heart of Niague, water the earth took years to filter. We chose to reveal it, intact.

chapters.title: The right gesture
chapters.text: Bottle at the source, adding nothing. Restraint as a requirement, purity as a result.

chapters.title: An owned ambition
chapters.text: To rival the world's best waters — and to do it from Senegal, for West Africa and beyond.

timeline.text: Cristal Waters SARL founded and the Niague site developed.
